record.question: What is the primary objective of radiation protection for occupationally exposed individuals?
options: To eliminate all exposure to ionizing radiation.
To reduce the probability of stochastic effects and avoid deterministic effects.
To ensure that all workers receive the same dose.
To only protect workers under the age of 18.
record.explanation: Answer B: To reduce the probability of stochastic effects and avoid deterministic effects.. Radiation protection aims to reduce stochastic-effect probability and prevent tissue reactions/deterministic effects. Reference: https://aerb.gov.in/english/radiation-protection-principle; https://aerb.gov.in/images/PDF/DiagnosticRadiology/REGULATORY-REQUIREMENTS-FOR-DIAGNOSTIC-RADIOLOGY-PRACTICE.pdf; https://nucleus.iaea.org/sites/nss-oui/Published%20Chunks/m_60b8e698-4f59-4c24-809a-dfb819ac5050/c_92a88144-44da-418c-a878-9c778590e687__9_0.Html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
